title: install-codex.mjs regen wipes custom fields inside managed block
body:
Diff the hand-edited managed block against the template and warn the user before regenerating it. Fields like [mcp_servers.dd.tools.orient]/retrieve approval_mode = "approve" that a user added inside BEGIN/END DD MANAGED CONFIG are not part of configBody in scripts/install-codex.mjs and get silently deleted on regen, since managedBlock() replaces everything between the markers verbatim. Surface this before applying, don't just apply and move on.

Why: Observed live: Project-Patriark's .codex/config.toml had approval_mode="approve" for orient and retrieve inside the managed block. Running the installer to refresh/update dropped both, reverting Codex to default (interactive) approval prompts for those two tools without the user asking for that change.

evidence.summary: configBody template (lines ~43-52) has no tools.*.approval_mode fields; managedBlock() fully replaces prior BEGIN/END content with this template
Post-install file lost [mcp_servers.dd.tools.orient] and [mcp_servers.dd.tools.retrieve] approval_mode="approve" blocks that were present pre-install
Anchored delivery: keywords validated against this memory's own text and a generic-request corpus before proposing.

v1.trigger: Before re-running scripts/install-codex.mjs (or dd install --host codex) against a project whose .codex/config.toml managed DD block was hand-edited
